links.comparator_used: Standardized prompt with no explicit reading-level instruction (first round)
links.outcome: Readability of GPT-5.1 plain-language explanations of kidney transplantation terms (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease rose from 23.6 ± 23.4 to 62.4 ± 7.5; mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level fell from 13.4 ± 4.8 to 6.3 ± 1.1; 46% of explanations needed college-level reading in round 1 vs all at middle school level or below in round 2
links.quote: Explicit readability-focused prompting substantially improved readability without compromising accuracy, underscoring the importance of prompt design when deploying LLMs for patient-centered education in transplantation.
